asset_id.title: Asset
asset_id.x-seam-query: SELECT id, tag_tecnico, name, type_id, criticality, purchase_price, arrival_date, status FROM assets WHERE ((name LIKE :q) OR (tag_tecnico LIKE :q)) ORDER BY name ASC
asset_id.x-seam-help: Table layout with seven typed columns, a Browse button and a detail line. The type is a lookup, not a JOIN.

model_id.title: Model
model_id.x-seam-query: SELECT id, name, brand_id FROM models WHERE (name LIKE :q) ORDER BY name ASC
model_id.x-seam-help: Rows layout: the key column on the first line, the rest on the second. No Browse button.

typed_asset_id.title: Asset by type
typed_asset_id.x-seam-query: SELECT a.id, a.name, t.name AS type_name, a.status FROM assets a JOIN asset_types t ON a.type_id = t.id WHERE ((a.name LIKE :q) OR (t.name LIKE :q)) ORDER BY a.name ASC
typed_asset_id.x-seam-help: One JOIN, because the search also matches the type's name. No layout set: the widget picks by the field's width. Five rows, an icon-only Browse button and a marker-style match.
